data.name: Woodland Stride
data.description: While wearing your astral suit, you may move through any sort of undergrowth at your normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Thorns, briars, and overgrown areas that are enchanted or magically manipulated to impede motion, however, still affect you.
